assets.description: Four open bins; two bright HD fire and two blood decals, full-coverage UVs, handbook-inspired orientations; no collisions.
Original supplied front artwork preserved as one texture; four true apertures fitted to its red-ring inner edges. Visual only.
White horizontal octagonal PVC ring only; 2.7 m across flats; no signs/collisions/physics.
Static collidable table and two open receiving trays. 0.61 m tabletop, height 0.75 m. No loose props.
Dynamic rigid body, mass 0.2 kg, gravity enabled by default; bottom origin. 70 mm diameter x 50 mm

coordinates: Z up, metres. Props/table bottom at Z=0; octagon origin at ring centre. Panel faces -Y.
physics_note: Dynamic props fall only if containing scene gravity is nonzero. Existing pool was previously zero-gravity; this generator does not change it. No buoyancy/underwater drag authored.
assumptions: Recon support layout, tray dimensions, panel aperture diameters (0.14/0.096 m) and stand dimensions are adjustable visual approximations, not certified official CAD. Octagon is ring only as requested; hanging signs not included.
texture_source: Panel: unmodified supplied image with UV crop. Task5: six built-in imagegen cartoon textures, original high-resolution output preserved. Original Recon decals unchanged.
validation: USD reopen, dependency resolution, Z-up/metres, collider and rigid-body counts, four aperture centre rays, four 0.2kg masses verified; CPU previews inspected. No live ZED or PhysX drop test performed.
revision: v2: exact panel artwork and ring alignment; six new bright high-resolution cartoon decals; round jar labels with margin.
recon_revision: v3 high-resolution fire/blood symbols, 305mm decals, full shapes and wide margins
